pr_title: Remove leading and trailing spaces before saving custom filter keyword
pr_comments:
In the absence of regular expressions, treating leading/trailing space as significant, when combined with disabling "whole word", can be a pretty powerful filtering option that I would hate to lose.

As a compromise, could the spaces just be made visually obvious somehow? This would let people quickly determine the root cause of the filter problem when spaces are *accidental*, while still allowing people to include leading/trailing space *on purpose* if desired.

If you can, please highlight this change prominently as a compatibility / functionality change in the release notes. Stripping whitespace from a filter term with "whole word" unchecked can significantly broaden matches - and if "hide completely" is selected for that filter, the user might not notice for quite some time.

issue_context.title: Trailing white spaces can make filters not work
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce the problem

1. Create a new filter in Settings → Filters  and deliberately add a trailing white space
2. Save the filter
3. Check your Timeline and if the filter is hiding posts containing the filtered words

### Expected behaviour

All posts with the words defined in the filter should be hidden.

### Actual behaviour

Some posts will still appear. 

### Detailed description

This looks like its obvious since of course the filter expression is taken literally. The filter will sometimes work, (when the filter expression is in a middle or beginning of a sentence) and sometimes not (for example when the word you actually want to block is followed by punctuation). 

However a trailing white space is easy to overlook and I already had it happen to me several times so that I thought the filter wasn't working at all. That the culprit is a trailing (or leading) white space is not obvious to the user and the resulting behavior confusing. 

I suggest to either make white space characters visible or trimming the filter expression when saving the filter to prevent this from happening. 

### Specifications

Mastodon v4.1.0
comments: Good catch! I'd be in favor of just stripping surrounding spaces. Need to think a bit more about whether this would break any use case, but I think it's pretty unlikely.
See [comment on PR #23883](https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/pull/23883#issuecomment-1666569965) - I'd like to propose keeping leading/trailing whitespace, but just making it visible instead.
That would be ideal, but I have no idea how to make those whitespaces more visible.

review_comments: You can use a `before_validation` callback instead of overriding the setter.

@Gargron , The ideal place to validate this is indeed a `before_validation`. Let me know if you still prefer the same. I can create a separate PR to make the changes in other places as well, to keep things uniform throughout the codebase.
